sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Collector

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: Easter eggs and References: The Secure container Kappa is modeled after the real life pistol case called the V100 by Pelican. As with the Secure container Gamma, the only differences between the real life counterpart and the in-game model is coloration.
